description: Residents are 85% satisfied with living in Saskatoon.
Top concerns are homelessness, crime, and housing.
Many support more city resources for housing and homelessness.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor Pearce noted Ward 3 residents' views on homelessness fees differ from survey.
Ward 3 residents already bear significant costs from homelessness.
Mayor Block questioned if survey respondents understand 'affordable housing' definition.
City will RFP 2026 survey to explore new methodologies and reduce margin of error.

description: Public survey highlights concerns on spending, homelessness, safety.
Employee survey supports plan, suggests simplifying priorities.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor Pearce noted 98% of her ward opposed a homelessness fee.
Will 'less services' feedback be actively considered during budget discussions?
63% of survey respondents were willing to pay a fee for homelessness.
Staff will present options for a statistically relevant survey for the next plan.

description: Saskatoon explores artificial intelligence for city services.
